name: Messages the product sends to people

failureModes.prompt: Could a message ever reach the wrong person, carrying somebody else's content?
failureModes.why: a message is the one mistake the product cannot take back

options.label: Recipient is resolved at send time and checked
Trust the stored address
options.consequence: faster, and a stale record sends private content to a stranger

failureModes.recommended: Recipient is resolved at send time and checked
failureModes.provenBy: a test that changes a person's address after queueing and asserts the message is not sent to the old one

failureModes.prompt: If sending is retried, could the same person receive the same message twice?
failureModes.why: a duplicate reminder reads as a broken product and a duplicate email reads as spam

options.label: Each message sends at most once
options.consequence: needs a record per message, no duplicates

options.label: Accept the occasional repeat
options.consequence: simpler, and retries become visible to people

failureModes.recommended: Each message sends at most once
failureModes.provenBy: a test that retries a failed send and asserts exactly one message left the system

failureModes.prompt: Has this person agreed to receive this kind of message?
failureModes.why: permission cannot be obtained after the message has already gone out

options.label: Checked against a stored preference every time
options.consequence: some people receive nothing, and that is correct

options.label: Send unless they have complained
options.consequence: wider reach, and a real legal and trust exposure

failureModes.recommended: Checked against a stored preference every time
failureModes.provenBy: a test that asserts no message is produced for a person who has opted out

failureModes.prompt: May this message arrive in the middle of somebody's night?
failureModes.why: people are in different places, and the send time is usually the server's, not theirs

options.label: Send when it is ready
options.consequence: simpler, and some people are woken up

failureModes.provenBy: a test asserting a send scheduled outside waking hours is deferred, not delivered

failureModes.prompt: If messages silently stop going out, how would we find out?
failureModes.why: nothing complains when a message is never sent, so this failure hides for weeks

options.label: An alert when the sent count drops
Notice when somebody reports it
options.consequence: nothing to build, and weeks of silence

failureModes.recommended: An alert when the sent count drops
failureModes.provenBy: the sent count visible on a dashboard with a threshold that would fire on zero

failureModes.prompt: What is the most a single person may receive in a week?
failureModes.why: each message is reasonable alone; the total is what makes people turn them off

options.label: A stated weekly cap
options.consequence: protects the channel, some messages are dropped

options.label: No cap for now
options.consequence: nothing to build, and the channel degrades quietly

failureModes.provenBy: a test asserting the cap holds when more messages than the limit are queued
